content.text:
**Finding: COMPLIANT (preferred position).**

No exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation binds Northwind. Clause 12.3 affirmatively preserves our freedom to engage any supplier and disclaims any exclusivity, non-compete, MFC, minimum-volume or no-hire commitment; clause 2.1 confirms there is no minimum quantity or purchase commitment and that declining further Order Forms is not a breach. The only exclusivity-type covenant (clause 12.4) restricts Brightline from competing with our analytics products — that runs in our favour and is not flagged. No redline proposed.
